why_angle: The guides cited give a generic 15-50 lb range and a 'go a size smaller between sizes' rule, and one quotes 20 lb per sq ft for a single pie-cut unit. None of them shows that Rev-A-Shelf's kidney ratings (25/50/64/84 lb for 18/24/28/32 in) all come from one area rating, so dropping from 28 to 24 in costs 22% of the capacity. None prices the units per rated pound, and none separates a bare bearing's rating from a shelf's rating. The pick, Rev-A-Shelf Lazy Daisy LD-2472, is not a product Dealectric lists, and none of our listed products wins any part of this question. Amazon search was walled and Rev-A-Shelf's own store shows the series as Coming Soon with no price, so I added no product record and the prices come from CSH Hardware, a retailer in the result set.

page.title: Turntable for a Cabinet: Lazy Susan Size Sets How Much It Holds
page.h1: Turntable for a cabinet: buy the largest kidney lazy susan that fits
page.desc: Rev-A-Shelf rates its kidney lazy susan shelves at 20 lb per sq ft, so a 28 in shelf holds 64 lb and a 24 in only 50 lb. Sizes, cabinet openings and prices.
page.answer: Short answer. The best turntable for a corner cabinet is a two-shelf kidney lazy susan in the largest size the cabinet fits, such as Rev-A-Shelf's Lazy Daisy LD-2472. Its shelves are rated at 20 lb per sq ft, so the 28 in holds 64 lb per shelf and the 24 in only 50 lb.

page.after:
What the differences mean

  • Going one size smaller costs about a fifth of the capacity. Moving from a 28 in to a 24 in Lazy Daisy takes each shelf from 64 lb to 50 lb. 50 ÷ 64 = 0.78, so that is 22% less.
  • A small shelf holds much less. The 18 in wall-cabinet shelf is rated at 25 lb, 30% of the 32 in base shelf's 84 lb (25 ÷ 84 = 0.30).
  • Bigger sets cost less per rated pound. The 28 in set is rated for 128 lb at $63.34, which is $0.49 per lb (63.34 ÷ 128). The 32 in works out to $0.45 (75.22 ÷ 168), the 24 in to $0.54 (53.92 ÷ 100) and the 18 in to $0.93 (46.36 ÷ 50). Prices are from CSH Hardware on 2026-11-10.
  • The chrome Dowell holds less. Dowell rates the 28 in 4001 270 at 40 lb per shelf, 62% of the Lazy Daisy 28 in (40 ÷ 64). The Dowell starts at $99.90, and the Lazy Daisy 28 in costs $63.34.
  • The wood round shelf has the highest rating for its area. Dowell's 18 in 4006 360 holds 50 lb on 1.77 sq ft (π × 9² = 254.5 sq in), which is 28.3 lb per sq ft. It is the strongest shelf here for jars and cans in a wall corner, but you get one shelf for $114.07.

Why a kidney lazy susan's rating grows with its size

Rev-A-Shelf lists the same Lazy Daisy polymer kidney shelves two ways. The almond listings say 20 lb per square foot, and the white listings give 25, 50, 64 and 84 lb per shelf for the 18, 24, 28 and 32 in sizes. The two agree once you work out the shelf area. A kidney shelf is a circle with a quarter cut away for the door (Dowell calls its kidney line "270 Degree"), so its area is 0.75 × π × r².

DiameterShelf areaArea × 20 lbRated per shelf
18 in1.33 sq ft26.5 lb25 lb
24 in2.36 sq ft47.1 lb50 lb
28 in3.21 sq ft64.1 lb64 lb
32 in4.19 sq ft83.8 lb84 lb

Area grows with the square of the diameter, and the rating grows with it. That makes the usual advice to go a size smaller when you are between sizes more expensive than it looks. To find your largest size, measure from each back wall to the inside edge of the opening, take the smaller of the two and subtract about 2 in (Cabinet Data). Then check the result against the Lazy Daisy minimum openings above.

A bearing rating is not a shelf rating. A bare lazy susan bearing carries far more than any shelf. Lily Bearing rates its steel bearings at 500 lb for 6 in and 1,000 lb for 12 in, and advises adding 25–30% to the expected load. Those numbers cover the bearing alone. In a finished unit the shelf sets the limit, at 25–84 lb for these kidney shelves. A high rating on a DIY bearing plate tells you nothing about the shelf you put on it.

Installation. Kidney shelves turn on bearings with stops, which bring the cut-out back to the door so the cabinet can close (Rev-A-Shelf). The telescoping Lazy Daisy post fits an interior height of 26–31 in. Like every 2- and 3-shelf corner set, it has to be assembled inside the cabinet before it is finally installed. Kidney units work only when the door is hinged to the cabinet. If the door rides on the shelves, you need a pie-cut unit.

Not recommended

The Dowell 4001 270 chrome kidney, for a heavily loaded pantry corner. At 28 in it is rated 40 lb per shelf, with a 13.5 lb limit on any single item (Dowell, as quoted by Kitchen Design Notes). It starts at $99.90, while the Lazy Daisy 28 in is rated 64 lb per shelf for $63.34. Choose the Dowell only if you want chrome wire and plan to store light items.
